purpose: Audit of existing concrete lifecycle, not a new executable state machine
trust: Local administrator, installer, pinned images, runtime, routing and Kubernetes remain trusted
ordering: Existing native runner records cleanup before original FINAL/report; later reconciliation remains separate. Conceptual lifecycle diagrams do not override actual journal grammar.

transitions.preconditions: Owned installation, fresh exact identities and fixed contract
transitions.authority: Restricted native runner; no fault capability yet
transitions.stateRead: Kubernetes UID/owner/image chain and signed boot identities
transitions.receiptOrObservation: Validated plan digest
transitions.crashOutcome: Absent or complete immutable plan; no fault attempted
transitions.retryAllowance: New explicit plan only; existing file is not replaced
transitions.reconciliation: No effect to reconcile
transitions.failureOrUncertainty: OPERATION_NOT_ATTEMPTED

transitions.preconditions: Exact explicit plan digest and current independent approver
transitions.authority: Installer approver private key
transitions.stateRead: Plan, claim absence, approver key
transitions.possibleExternalEffect: No remote mutation; creates run-scoped private capabilities
transitions.receiptOrObservation: Public approval reference follows in a separate publication
transitions.crashOutcome: One half may exist; no automatic reissue or replacement
transitions.retryAllowance: Existing capability publication consumes this directory; explicit new plan for retry
transitions.reconciliation: Original protected capability only; never infer authority from public evidence
transitions.failureOrUncertainty: OPERATION_NOT_ATTEMPTED; missing public half denies integrated admission

transitions.preconditions: Original authorization was created
transitions.authority: Original approver; distinct signature domain
transitions.stateRead: Full native plan, invocation, grant commitment and authority fingerprints
transitions.receiptOrObservation: Independent approver signature
transitions.crashOutcome: Absent or complete reference; original authorization may remain private
transitions.retryAllowance: No replacement; no authority refresh
transitions.reconciliation: Use intact original capability if cleanup is required
transitions.failureOrUncertainty: Missing reference is denial, never implicit approval

transitions.preconditions: Current approval and dedicated witness key
transitions.authority: Witness key, no Apply/Remove authority
transitions.stateRead: Exact reference, registration window, original targets and budgets
transitions.receiptOrObservation: Signed registration with random process/session identities
transitions.crashOutcome: Incomplete directory or complete registration; no observation invented
transitions.retryAllowance: New session only
transitions.reconciliation: No fault cleanup authority
transitions.failureOrUncertainty: OPERATION_NOT_ATTEMPTED

transitions.preconditions: Exact registered key and at least full observation budget remaining
transitions.authority: Witness key directory and OS file lock
transitions.stateRead: Bounded key-local consumed-session set
transitions.receiptOrObservation: Protected durable claims
transitions.crashOutcome: Claim may exist without START; cannot resume or roll back
transitions.retryAllowance: Same session denied even in a copied output directory
transitions.reconciliation: Operator retains evidence and rotates an exhausted key explicitly
transitions.failureOrUncertainty: Missing START does not prove a live session

transitions.preconditions: Claims consumed; fixed original data path and identity checks
transitions.authority: Dedicated observation-only principal and signing key
transitions.stateRead: Fresh direct/proxy/application/authority responses
transitions.persistentIntent: Each signed append followed by Sync
transitions.receiptOrObservation: Nonce-bound signed replies and witness client measurements
transitions.crashOutcome: Keep complete signed prefix and exact torn tail; no repair
transitions.retryAllowance: No session resumption
transitions.reconciliation: Runner/proxy expiry independent
transitions.failureOrUncertainty: Observation loss is missing evidence

transitions.preconditions: At least three real healthy baseline groups, original identities confirmed
transitions.authority: Witness signing key
transitions.stateRead: Its own signed prefix, no active approved invocation
transitions.receiptOrObservation: Registration-bound signed READY hash
transitions.crashOutcome: READY may be in journal without ready.json; no admission from a missing half
transitions.retryAllowance: No replacement or invented READY
transitions.reconciliation: Original invocation may be fenced independently
transitions.failureOrUncertainty: Readiness is not evidence that Apply occurred

transitions.preconditions: Current external exact witness policy and valid live READY prefix
transitions.authority: Original Apply private key; no witness private key
transitions.stateRead: Registration, approval, READY, original capability and policy snapshot
transitions.receiptOrObservation: Apply nonce commits to READY, registration, approval and signed intent
transitions.crashOutcome: One half may exist; no automatic retries
transitions.retryAllowance: A duplicate intent/admission is denied
transitions.reconciliation: Use original capability; do not reconstruct missing records
transitions.failureOrUncertainty: OPERATION_NOT_ATTEMPTED until runner Apply intent

transitions.preconditions: Exact original authorization and one-use directory
transitions.authority: Native runner original Apply capability
transitions.stateRead: Plan, invocation, authorization and claim absence
transitions.persistentIntent: Exclusive claim.json, new journal, CLAIMED append+Sync
transitions.receiptOrObservation: Original hash-chained runner prefix
transitions.crashOutcome: Any existing claim prevents another run; no resume
transitions.retryAllowance: Never retry a claimed invocation as new execution
transitions.reconciliation: Original cleanup capability can fence invocation
transitions.failureOrUncertainty: OPERATION_NOT_ATTEMPTED without APPLY_INTENT

transitions.preconditions: Fresh original Kubernetes/boot check, baseline preflight, lifecycle gate, no stop
transitions.authority: Exact original Apply key and grant
transitions.stateRead: Stop, target, grant lifetime, ready commitment
transitions.possibleExternalEffect: One signed Apply request may reach exact proxy
transitions.receiptOrObservation: Signed Apply receipt or explicit acknowledgement uncertainty
transitions.crashOutcome: Durable intent without receipt means unknown effect; never infer absence
transitions.retryAllowance: No automatic Apply retry or execution resume
transitions.reconciliation: Fresh original identity plus separate Remove; local expiry remains independent
transitions.failureOrUncertainty: ATTEMPTED_WITH_UNKNOWN_EFFECT until authenticated receipt

transitions.preconditions: Valid grant/command and latched original proxy/peers; control serialization
transitions.authority: Original approver grant plus Apply command signature
transitions.stateRead: Binding, boot, retained epochs, registry/journal limits and live peers
transitions.persistentIntent: Control journal Apply-INTENT append+Sync before mutation
transitions.receiptOrObservation: Private intent; later public signed state is separate
transitions.crashOutcome: Interrupted admission must never become permission for an ambiguous retry
transitions.retryAllowance: At most one admitted effect; consumed/poisoned attempts fail closed
transitions.reconciliation: Original Remove fences; independent local timer for any applied effect
transitions.failureOrUncertainty: Attempted/known-unapplied/unknown disposition requires actual boundary evidence

transitions.preconditions: Durable intact intent, live context/grant and same original binding
transitions.authority: Exact original Apply authority only
transitions.stateRead: Original invocation and active slot under fault mutex
transitions.possibleExternalEffect: Bounded response delay; monotonic deadline set once
transitions.receiptOrObservation: Retained signed state and per-request signed invocation/hold
transitions.crashOutcome: New process has new boot/key and no inherited binding or active effect
transitions.retryAllowance: Duplicate returns original receipt; never recreates or extends
transitions.reconciliation: Original Remove or independent expiry
transitions.historicalVerdict: Only conditional candidate after independent measurements
transitions.failureOrUncertainty: EFFECT_INDEPENDENTLY_CONFIRMED requires additional actual traffic

transitions.preconditions: Original mutation may already have happened
transitions.authority: Proxy response key
transitions.stateRead: Retained exact invocation, plan and original nonce
transitions.receiptOrObservation: Signed reply plus separate retained-authority receipt
transitions.crashOutcome: Lost reply remains unknown; authenticated status may establish current state
transitions.retryAllowance: Status is read-only; no automatic new Apply
transitions.reconciliation: Original identity cleanup remains possible without runner report
transitions.historicalVerdict: INCONCLUSIVE if original attempt is unresolved
transitions.failureOrUncertainty: Missing acknowledgement is neither absence nor success

transitions.preconditions: Live registered session, own fresh requests, original identity/authority correlation
transitions.authority: Witness signing key and read-only data access
transitions.stateRead: Direct/proxy/application timings and signed retained grant/deadline
transitions.persistentIntent: Bounded signed JSONL append and Sync
transitions.receiptOrObservation: Independent effect and application contract samples
transitions.crashOutcome: Short write/Sync failure poisons; death preserves prefix, never END
transitions.retryAllowance: No resume or fabricated samples
transitions.reconciliation: Witness death cannot block original expiry or runner cleanup
transitions.historicalVerdict: Credible FAIL retained; insufficient effect/coverage INCONCLUSIVE
transitions.failureOrUncertainty: EFFECT_INDEPENDENTLY_CONFIRMED is distinct from acknowledgement

transitions.preconditions: Original active epoch, functioning process/scheduler/clock
transitions.authority: Local proxy timer and request-path guard; no remote actor required
transitions.stateRead: Original monotonic deadline
transitions.possibleExternalEffect: Stops new imposed delay and interrupts in-flight wait
transitions.receiptOrObservation: Signed retained original inactive/expired state
transitions.crashOutcome: Process death does not inherit effect; loss of traffic is not recovery
transitions.retryAllowance: Never renew on duplicate Apply or polling
transitions.reconciliation: Independent original Remove may additionally fence
transitions.cleanupAuthority: Original Remove for explicit cleanup confirmation
transitions.failureOrUncertainty: EFFECT_EXPIRED; not TRAFFIC_RECOVERED or RESOURCES_CLEANED

transitions.preconditions: Original protected authority and fresh original identity
transitions.authority: Distinct original cleanup key; lifecycle gate orders stop against Apply/finalization
transitions.stateRead: Canonical stop, original authorization, current state
transitions.persistentIntent: Durable stop before Remove; cleanup journal receipt separately
transitions.possibleExternalEffect: Original invocation is stopped/fenced; no replacement target adoption
transitions.receiptOrObservation: Signed inactive/fenced receipt; actual recovery measured separately
transitions.crashOutcome: Missing reply/publication retains cleanup uncertainty; expiry independent
transitions.retryAllowance: Idempotent original Remove; no new fault
transitions.reconciliation: Reconciliation never rewrites historical bytes
transitions.cleanupAuthority: Original cleanup key with unchanged expiry
transitions.failureOrUncertainty: Resources cleaned refers to inactive/fenced fault, not deleting application Pods

transitions.preconditions: Sufficient prior effect and original identity; independent traffic requests
transitions.authority: Witness and original unsigned observer separately
transitions.stateRead: Own client measurements, nested original signatures, inactive original state
transitions.persistentIntent: Signed witness recovery samples and terminal append+Sync
transitions.receiptOrObservation: Healthy actual application traffic, ceiling and baseline margin
transitions.crashOutcome: Expiry, endpoint disappearance and missing terminal cannot synthesize recovery
transitions.retryAllowance: No session resume
transitions.reconciliation: Recovery does not imply original cleanup COMPLETE
transitions.historicalVerdict: FAIL preserved; otherwise incomplete evidence stays INCONCLUSIVE
transitions.failureOrUncertainty: TRAFFIC_RECOVERED is independent of EFFECT_EXPIRED

transitions.preconditions: Original cleanup/result evaluation; final identity and stop checked under lifecycle gate
transitions.authority: Runner holding original capability, existing source evaluator
transitions.stateRead: Actual original observer, own journal and accepted stop
transitions.persistentIntent: FINAL append+Sync then exclusive original report.json
transitions.receiptOrObservation: Original source execution/candidate/cleanup
transitions.crashOutcome: May have FINAL without report; never invent missing report after death
transitions.retryAllowance: No overwrite or resume
transitions.reconciliation: Later receipts remain separate
transitions.historicalVerdict: PASS requires all original prerequisites; cancellation/uncertainty blocks it
transitions.failureOrUncertainty: Completed history is immutable, not current-state attestation

transitions.preconditions: Completed original report and exact journal/intent available
transitions.authority: Original Apply authority, distinct assertion signature domain
transitions.stateRead: Original report canonical digest, raw journal digest, intent digest
transitions.receiptOrObservation: Run-scoped signature binds original cancellation/candidate/cleanup
transitions.crashOutcome: Missing signature stays explicit and cannot be retroactively invented by publisher
transitions.retryAllowance: No replacement
transitions.reconciliation: Cleanup does not alter assertion/history
transitions.historicalVerdict: Original candidate remains separate; missing assertion blocks complete corroboration
transitions.failureOrUncertainty: Signer assertion is not whole-execution attestation

transitions.preconditions: Intact original capability and exact original target; live identity validated
transitions.authority: Separate original cleanup key
transitions.stateRead: Original plan/grant/target and historical byte digests
transitions.receiptOrObservation: Signed current response and unchanged historical hashes
transitions.crashOutcome: Cleanup may occur without receipt publication; retain PENDING/UNKNOWN
transitions.retryAllowance: Idempotent current-state reconciliation only
transitions.reconciliation: Never infer a new target from a journal
transitions.cleanupAuthority: Same original key and expiry, not refreshed authority
transitions.failureOrUncertainty: RESOURCES_CLEANED is a new observation, not rewritten history

transitions.preconditions: Explicit original run/session paths and public-only nine-artifact mapping
transitions.authority: Operator read access only; no fault authority exercised
transitions.stateRead: Stable bounded source reads, signed correlations and optional later receipt
transitions.persistentIntent: Exclusive public export files; incomplete exports are not signed complete bundles
transitions.receiptOrObservation: Typed curated result and lossless bounded raw JSONL wrappers
transitions.crashOutcome: Missing/changed source fails conservatively or preserves a verified incomplete prefix
transitions.retryAllowance: New export directory only; never repair historical bytes
transitions.reconciliation: No cleanup action from export
transitions.historicalVerdict: Source candidate unchanged; uncertain claims cannot acquire witness authority
transitions.failureOrUncertainty: Read snapshot is not a global filesystem transaction

transitions.preconditions: Explicit signer and curated public source, supported consistent mapping
transitions.authority: Dedicated publisher key, distinct from all source/witness roles
transitions.stateRead: Two bounded artifact sweeps with file identity/bytes checks
transitions.persistentIntent: Complete in-memory signed manifest commits full inventory
transitions.receiptOrObservation: Publisher signature over exact bytes; external trust remains separate
transitions.crashOutcome: A changed/missing source cannot produce an assumed successful full snapshot
transitions.retryAllowance: New explicit publication; no historical mutation
transitions.reconciliation: None
transitions.failureOrUncertainty: Signing does not independently establish execution truth

transitions.preconditions: Complete bounded signed archive and operator-controlled output directory
transitions.authority: Publisher filesystem write, no runner/witness authority
transitions.stateRead: Final-path absence; synced temporary complete bytes
transitions.persistentIntent: Write+Sync+close temporary, atomic exclusive hard link, supported directory Sync
transitions.possibleExternalEffect: Creates one complete final file; concurrent loser cannot replace winner
transitions.receiptOrObservation: Actual final file and output metadata
transitions.crashOutcome: Before link final absent; after link complete file may exist despite lost success acknowledgement
transitions.retryAllowance: Never overwrite existing final; retry must inspect/use a different explicit path
transitions.reconciliation: Abandoned temporary file is retained evidence for operator, not a fault resource
transitions.historicalVerdict: Verifier execution success remains distinct from reliability candidate
transitions.failureOrUncertainty: No valid partial archive; Sync alone does not prove power-loss durability

transitions.preconditions: Only explicit public bundle and independently supplied policies plus one verification clock
transitions.authority: Public verification keys; no execution or cleanup capability
transitions.stateRead: Bounded signed envelope, supported mappings, exact scope, validity/revocation
transitions.receiptOrObservation: Separate integrity, trust, signature, identity, effect, recovery and source findings
transitions.crashOutcome: Interrupted verification has no success claim or remote effect
transitions.retryAllowance: Read-only verification may be repeated with explicit current policy/clock
transitions.reconciliation: No cleanup action
transitions.failureOrUncertainty: Unknown/revoked/expired/rotated signer is untrusted; unsupported or missing evidence never PASS
